description: Who is this address? From operator address registries (Aave, Morpho, Spark, Grove, Sky, Euler, Compound, Fluid, Pendle, Yearn, Lido, Ethena), our own vault index (a vault holding another vault), the contract’s own on-chain self-description, and explorer tags: label, class (protocol_liquidity, vault, protocol, exchange, custodian, market_maker, treasury, agent), source, date checked and confidence. An address no source names comes back unidentified with its shape (wallet, multisig, contract), never as a person. With vault: the identified holders among its largest. Without either: how much of the largest holders’ capital is named, by class. FREE.

vault.description: A vault slug or id: its named holders.

name: address_identity

form.description: Which form answered (2026-11-25). A field null because it belongs to another form is listed in notApplicable: null there is not applicable, never unknown and never an empty reading.

identity.description: With address: who it is; null when unidentified or in the vault and summary forms.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

named.description: With vault: its identified largest holders; null otherwise.

notApplicable.description: The fields null on this form because they belong to another one.

says.description: With address: one sentence; null in the vault and summary forms.

shape.description: With address: what kind of address it is; null otherwise.

summary.description: Without address or vault: counts by source and class; null otherwise.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Who an address is
